items.title: Try Flow on Android. You’ll never type again.
items.description: Today we launched the version we believe those 4 billion people deserve. And it is the first time voice on Android feels like a primary interface, not a fallback feature.

items.title: Wispr Flow launches an Android app for AI-powered dictation | TechCrunch
items.description: The app can support translation in over 100 languages and can work across other apps. Wispr Flow said it has done an infrastructure rewrite that makes dictation 30% faster than before.
